objective: Abstain on incomplete or ambiguously placed supplied context evidenced by unconstrained phonetic content; preserve frozen acoustic model, full raw paths/endpoints and .5/.1 word/phone gates.
data_status: Original cases01-10 and observed14fresh cases are DEVELOPMENT/VALIDATION now. No new final heldout access is authorized before freeze.

bounds.optimal_path_tie_policy: diagonal then delete-expected then insert-observed; pronunciation input order; deterministic

threshold_reason: At least three model-supported phone events over120ms indicates a short content fragment rather than a single-phone confusion or one-frame boundary disagreement. These uncalibrated scores are not correctness probabilities.

finite_candidates.residual_definition: A contiguous run of inserted observed greedy phones in minimum-unit-edit correspondence against any allowed pronunciation path.

finite_candidates.only_if: Iteration1 fails to detect known omitted-content negative; no other tuning.
finite_candidates.residual_definition: A contiguous observed run of inserted OR substituted greedy phones; expected-phone deletions do not add audio or break observed contiguity.

selection_rule: Use iteration1 if it meets mechanism and coverage checks. Evaluate at most iteration2 if omitted-content negative still offers. Never change posterior, duration or run-count thresholds after viewing outcomes.

development_quality_gates.mechanism: All critical negative cases must have0wordoffers, including omitted repeated-prefix context and prior substituted-word/silence diagnostics.
development_quality_gates.coverage: At least40percent of eligible positive words offered overall AND at least80percent of v1 offeredpositivewords retained on paired same cases.
development_quality_gates.negative_monotonicity: No negative offers can be added, and previously rejected silence/noise/clearlywrongtext/substitutedword cases stay rejected.
development_quality_gates.span_invariance: All retained offers preserve exactly the frozen candidate endpoint samples and base scores.
development_quality_gates.honesty: Report false context refusals, abstained correct words, raw residual paths, unmatched phones and coverage denominators. Passing development does not establish safe product behavior.
development_quality_gates.start_end_quality: Offered absolute start/endp95<=80ms each against explicit available support references; natural interior words excluded from timing denominators, never silently treated correct.
development_quality_gates.signal_quality: Every offered positive interval own-signalenergy>=90percent andforeign-wordenergy<=0.1percent using currentexplicitconstructionreference definitions.
development_quality_gates.premeasurement_revision: Root supplied stricter gates before any candidate measurement; earlier50percentretention/25percentoverall gates superseded.

stop_rule: Stop/report if finite candidates cannot detect incomplete context without losing declared useful coverage; do not blacklist caseIDs or change supplied text.
final_test: Freeze candidate source/dependency SHA before Root supplies new oracle-free inputs. Root will restrict filesystem truth access and grade outside inference.
